lastCompletedStory.title: Make cam review a thin signal-writer gated on sidecar liveness

nextStoryContext: runReview (src/commands/review.ts) now writes phase:review to .claude/cam-loop.local.md via buildReviewBody + writeStateFile, gated by sidecarLivenessGate(claudeDir, 'review', options.sidecarAliveFn) before the write -- exact same order as runPlan/runShip (liveness/bootstrap preamble -> paneCountMutex busy-refusal -> sidecarLivenessGate -> build+write). getOrchPaneId/sendKeysWhenIdle/capturePaneFn machinery was removed entirely from review.ts (no longer needed once the write IS the signal). test/review.test.ts was moved to test/commands/review.test.ts and rewritten to assert on parseStateFile(writeCalls[0].body) instead of grepping spawnFn.calls for send-keys argv (mirrors test/plan.test.ts / test/ship.test.ts 1:1). Next up (US-003): runSidecarLoop (src/supervisor/loop.ts) does NOT yet dispatch on phase:review -- add an injected runReviewPhaseFn?: () => void | Promise<void> to RunSidecarLoopOptions (next to runPlanPhaseFn L2114 / runShipPhaseFn L2133) and a dispatch branch mirroring the planning (L2222) / shipping (L2247) branches, including the same throwing-fn outer guard (the planning branch's guard at L2223 is the template). US-004 then wires the production review-phase closure (one makeReviewDispatch round) and US-005 collapses the cam-review template + drops subagent-reviewer from the orch Task allowlist -- do not start that cleanup until US-003/US-004 land, since the orchestrator-side /cam-review slash command and subagent-reviewer template are still load-bearing until the sidecar-side dispatch exists.
